metaTitle: About Brazos Ridge Fence Co. | Farm & Ranch Fencing Experts in Central Texas
metaDescription: Brazos Ridge Fence Co. builds farm and ranch fencing across Waco and Central Texas. Honest pricing, free written estimates, and fence built to hold cattle.
h1: Fence Builders Who Know Ranch Country
heroSub: We build farm and ranch fence across Waco and Central Texas. Straight lines, tight wire, honest numbers, and a crew that picks up the phone.
storyHtml:
Brazos Ridge Fence Co. is a farm and ranch fencing outfit based in Waco, Texas. We work the same country our customers do, from the river bottoms along the Brazos to the limestone hills out toward Crawford and Valley Mills. Our whole business is fence for working land: pastures, hay ground, hunting places, and homesteads across McLennan, Bosque, and Falls counties.

We got into this work because we saw too many landowners paying good money for fence that sagged in two summers. A fence is only as good as its corners, its brace posts, and the crew that stretched the wire. So we build barbed wire, pipe fence, high game fence, and ranch entrance gates the way they ought to be built, set deep and stretched tight.

We keep the business side just as straight as the fence lines. Every job starts with a free written estimate that spells out your cost per foot, your materials, and your timeline, with no surprises tacked on at the end. If you want to see how pricing works before you ever call us, our ranch fence cost guide lays out real numbers.

We're licensed and insured, and we answer the phone when things go wrong, not just when there's a sale to make. Storm takes down a fence line or cattle get out at 2 a.m., our emergency line at (254) 555-0184 is open around the clock. That's what it means to be a neighbor in this business, and we aim to earn that word on every job.

values.title: Built to Hold
values.desc: Corners set in concrete, braces done right, wire stretched tight. We build fence to outlast the note on the truck that hauled it in.

values.title: Straight Numbers
values.desc: You get a free written estimate with real per-foot pricing before we drive a single post. The price we quote is the price you pay.

values.title: We Know Cattle
values.desc: We fence for the animal, not just the property line. Wire spacing, gate placement, and corner layout all come from time spent around livestock.

values.title: There When It Matters
values.desc: Our 24/7 emergency line covers storm damage and cattle-out calls. When your fence is down, waiting until Monday isn't an option.

faq.q: What areas does Brazos Ridge Fence Co. serve?
faq.a: We're based in Waco and cover McLennan, Bosque, and Falls counties. That includes China Spring, Crawford, McGregor, Valley Mills, Lorena, West, and the ranch country in between. If you're close to that footprint, call us and we'll tell you straight whether we can get to you.

faq.q: What kinds of fence do you build?
faq.a: Farm and ranch fence is all we do. That means barbed wire, pipe fence, high game fence for deer and exotics, and custom ranch entrance gates. We don't chase subdivision privacy fence work, so our crews stay sharp on the fencing that working land actually needs.

Estimates are free and always in writing. We walk your fence line with you, talk through terrain, gates, and materials, then put per-foot pricing on paper so you can compare it against anybody. There's no charge and no pressure to sign on the spot.
